title: Asahina Mafuyu — A Pair Of Smiles〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's see... Do you see Ena and Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It doesn't look like they're around.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay... I was hoping that we could listen to this demo together, but I guess they're not here yet.
Looking for Ena and Mizuki? They're doing something very interesting over there.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Luka...!
Wait, what do you mean by interesting?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. You'll know when you see.
They're this way.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, I've gathered up all the edge pieces... What do we do next?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... Wanna start by connecting them all together? There aren't that many, so we should be able to tackle that part pretty quickly if we all work together.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, nice timing, you two!
Wanna join us?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
It's apparently called a “white puzzle”...
It's literally all white. No pictures or anything.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's right!
Luka asked me to bring over something to pass the time!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Finishing this won't be easy, so you guys should be able to spend plenty of time trying to figure it out.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Thank you, Mizuki.
I'm sure they'll enjoy solving it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Luka, aren't you going to do it? I thought you asked Mizuki for it...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Watching Rin and the others try to solve it should be more than entertaining enough.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Are you making fun of us?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Bringing a puzzle over is fine and all...
But aren't we here to listen to that demo together?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, this seems really hard anyway, so we can pick away at it little by little.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Good luck, all of you.
I hope you manage to finish it someday.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I wasn't that interested myself, but Rin's gotten really worked up about it...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I said that I'd finish it. So I swear I'm going to finish it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That right there is called getting worked up.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hey. Explain to me why I have to do this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Because Rin wants to finish it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's not my problem. If you want to help her, then you help her.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, MEIKO, how did you do that?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I've fulfilled my duty.
The rest is up to you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Wouldn't it be easier just to do it, KAITO? You'll be free to go once you've finished.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'll be done in no time...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, you're down to the last two pieces?!
That's amazing!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But it seemed so challenging.
You must've all worked really hard.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, Luka, did you never work on it in the end?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
No, I did...
But I had more fun seeing sides of the others that I never knew about.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Anyway, Miku, the pieces you and Mafuyu are holding are the last ones.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Let's see...
We just need to place them in the middle here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There's mine. You have the last one, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But what do we do with it?
It's all white. It'd be kinda weird to hang it up.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In that case, why not take it apart and start over from scratch?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Y-You're joking, right?! We worked so hard on it...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I didn't dislike the puzzle... Or the way it brought us together like this.)
